floors.cause: Held-out questions, written before any v0.2 code. v0.2 (v02-holdout, 3 trials) is right on 40 of 84 and wrong on 14 of 54 answered (25.9%); v0.1 (v02-holdout-before) was right on 12 of 84 and wrong on 37 of 49 (75.5%). Of v0.2's 14 wrong answers, 6 give the right names and values but the gold also returns an id column (ho-020, ho-024); 3 do the same and also pick another tied technician for fifth place (ho-028); 3 differ only in the order of tied rows (ho-022); 2 are a misread (ho-010). Most of the shortfall in accuracy is 10 questions v0.2 cannot express (durations, products of fields, "has none", distinct periods, a subquery), refused in every trial.
floors.next: The held-out golds keep their id-column convention, fixed before the runs. The v0.2 prompt and grammar are not changed after seeing these results.
